crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to Yahweh to gaze, and many of them perish.
Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered…
“This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.
When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover…
“When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves…
but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”
The secret things belong to Yahweh our God; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever…
Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzzah; and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by God’s ark.
When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him, because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.
Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has…
For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to…

people.name: Beth-shemesh
people.line: City in Judah, associated with the Ark's return.

translations.web: He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into Yahweh’s ark, he struck fifty thousand seventy of the men. Then the people mourned, because Yahweh had struck the people with a great slaughter.
translations.bsb: But God struck down some of the people of Beth-shemesh because they looked inside the ark of the LORD. He struck down seventy men, and the people mourned because the LORD had struck them with a great slaughter.
translations.kjv: And he smote the men of Bethshemesh, because they had looked into the ark of the LORD, even he smote of the people fifty thousand and threescore and ten men: and the people lamented, because the LORD had smitten many of the people with a great slaughter.
translations.asv: And he smote of the men of Beth-shemesh, because they had looked into the ark of Jehovah, he smote of the people seventy men, and fifty thousand men; and the people mourned, because Jehovah had smitten the people with a great slaughter.
